SUMMARY SHEET ON THE 1969 JUL 25 EARTHQUAKE (SHEET 2 OF 3)

Intensity VII zone - East-west about 20 km long;

north-south about 10 km long

- 10 762 houses collapsed
35 965 heavily damaged
90 840 damaged

- 33 people died
236 seriously injured
762 slightly injured

- Most type I houses collapsed,
others heavily damaged

- A few type II houses collapsed,
others damaged

- Some type HI houses had no damage

- Cracks in the ground

- Flow from springs changed

- One landslide (225 m’)

Intensity VII zone - Major axis ENE, about 6 km long;

north-south about 20 km wide

- Most type I houses damaged,
some collapsed

- Most type II houses damaged,
some heavily damaged

- Most type Il houses remained intact,
a few damaged

- Cracks in the ground

- Hundreds of cases of sand and water
ejection

- Some landslides (max. 160 m°)

Intensity VI zone - Major axis ENE, about 100 km long
- A few type I houses heavily damaged
and collapsed
- No major damage to type II houses

Xinyi - Over 10 houses collapsed
- 1 200 houses partially collapsed

Deging - Felt by many persons
- Hanging objects swung
- Windows and doors rattled
- Cracks in 6 houses widened

Fengkai - Roof tiles rattled
